title: Bolsista Doutor - Bcs Sistemas - Estimular O Uso Do Smartphone No Dia A Dia No Comércio Varejista |
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo. O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Inovar o varejo por meio da tecnologia é o que impulsiona a BCS SISTEMAS, e você pode ser parte dessa transformação. Estamos em busca de talentos criativos, proativos e estratégicos para integrar um projeto que visa desenvolver soluções móveis inteligentes, promovendo o uso efetivo de smartphones no dia a dia das operações do comércio varejista.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar desde o mapeamento de processos e pesquisa de campo com lojistas e usuários do ERP, até a prototipação, desenvolvimento, integração e validação de aplicativos com tecnologias como nuvem, banco de dados, inteligência artificial, dashboards e notificações — tudo conectado ao ecossistema do nosso ERP.

Se você gosta de aliar tecnologia à experiência do usuário, tem familiaridade com soluções móveis e deseja causar impacto real em um setor essencial da economia, essa vaga é para você.

Formação Acadêmica

Doutorado completo em Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Análise de Sistemas, Sistemas da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Dados, Tecnologia ou áreas afins.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto

Estimular o uso do smartphone no dia a dia no comércio varejista.

Principais Atividades

  • Mapeamento de Processos Operacionais no Varejo
  • Pesquisa de Campo com Lojistas e Usuários do ERP
  • Prototipação de Soluções Móveis
  • Desenvolvimento e Integração com o ERP
  • Validação em Campo e Iterações de Produto
  • Planejamento de Escalonamento e Estratégia de Adoção
  • Avaliação de Impacto e Documentação Técnica
  • Transferência de Conhecimento e Capacitação Interna

Conhecimento Necessário

  • Desenvolvimento de Aplicativos Móveis
  • UX / UI Design para Mobilidade

Conhecimento Desejável

  • Pesquisa Aplicada e Validação de Soluções em Campo
  • Gestão da Inovação e Desenvolvimento de Produtos
  • Análise de Dados e Tomada de Decisão

Diferenciais

title: Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica - (Cópia)
description:
Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica

O Técnico de Engenharia Clínica é o profissional técnico responsável por assegurar o funcionamento contínuo, seguro e eficaz do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele executa manutenções preventivas, corretivas, calibrações e ensaios, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para o atendimento ao paciente, em conformidade com as normas técnicas e os procedimentos internos. Sua atuação é fundamental para a segurança do paciente e a eficiência operacional da instituição de saúde.

  • Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas: Realizar manutenções corretivas nos equipamentos médico-hospitalares, desde a abertura do chamado até a identificação da falha e a intervenção técnica, visando restaurar todas as funcionalidades e retomar a operação de forma segura. Executar manutenções planejadas/programadas (preventivas e preditivas), utilizando padrões e simuladores adequados, para garantir que os equipamentos estejam sempre aptos para uso seguro, com laudos e certificados válidos. Realizar calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica nos equipamentos, seguindo os procedimentos e normas técnicas aplicáveis, para assegurar a precisão e a segurança dos dispositivos.
  • Gestão de Equipamentos e Controle Patrimonial: Realizar o controle e rastreio de equipamentos por meio de rondas diárias, verificando o estado geral, a localização e a condição de uso, para garantir sua conservação e disponibilidade. Acompanhar o recebimento de novos equipamentos e insumos, conferindo notas fiscais e a contagem dos produtos, e testando os equipamentos para verificar sua aptidão para o uso. Preservar e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, mantendo-os organizados, limpos e conservados, e solicitando novas ferramentas ao supervisor quando necessário, demonstrando cuidado com o patrimônio da empresa.
  • Documentação e Registro no Sistema: Alimentar o sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), realizando a abertura de Ordens de Serviço (OS) e preenchendo detalhadamente as ações executadas, peças utilizadas e observações, para garantir um histórico preciso e completo do equipamento. Assegurar a correta emissão de laudos e certificados de acordo com as normativas vigentes, após a execução das manutenções e calibrações.
  • Acompanhamento e Suporte: Manter o supervisor imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e os desafios encontrados, buscando soluções e alinhando as atividades diariamente. Acompanhar as atividades de serviços realizados por terceiros dentro da unidade, por meio da análise de ordens de serviço externas, para garantir o registro e histórico completo dos equipamentos. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo que venham a ser delegadas pelo supervisor de engenharia clínica.
  • Relacionamento e Otimização: Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações conforme a necessidade do cliente, através do contato com fornecedores, com o objetivo de apoiar a ampliação dos serviços e soluções oferecidas.

Job description

Você estará em uma equipe horizontal e transparente, que não apenas valoriza suas ideias, mas também espera que você faça parte da construção da empresa com a gente.

  • Mapear processos existentes e desenhar novas entregas de serviços e automações;

Join to apply for the Curriculum Manager (Software Engineering Outcomes) - 13454 role at Somewhere

Working hours: Mon-Fri, online 4-5 hours EDT overlap or Full EDT business hours

Holidays: 10 holidays (combined US and local) with/ prior advice

About the Role

We are seeking a Curriculum Manager (Software Engineering Outcomes) to design and deliver practical, results-driven training modules that help students land interviews and secure jobs faster. This role is central to scaling our outcomes program by consistently creating high-impact content while reducing reliance on the founder for curriculum development.

As Curriculum Manager, you will research industry best practices, translate insights into structured modules, and oversee the end-to-end delivery of lessons, worksheets, and assignments. Your success will be measured by how effectively the curriculum accelerates student wins, improves engagement, and generates success stories.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives on deadlines, values outcomes over theory, and is motivated by helping aspiring engineers break into tech careers.

Role Responsibilities

  • Consistent Release of Modules
    • Ship 1 new training module every 2 weeks.
    • Each module includes clear lessons, worksheets, assignments, grading criteria, and is fully ready to upload.
  • Faster Student Wins
    • Students who use new modules should get their first interview faster (about 1-2 weeks quicker than before).
  • Higher Student Engagement
    • More students should complete the “first win” tasks in their first week (for example, reaching out to recruiters, getting responses, or passing a coding screen).
    • Target: at least 20% more students completing first-week tasks compared to before.
  • Student Success Stories
    • Collect at least 3 new testimonials or case studies every month that directly tie back to the modules you create.
  • Freeing the Founder’s Time
    • Reduce the founder’s role in curriculum work to 1-2 hours per week (mainly reviewing and recording, not creating from scratch).
  • Relevant, Useful Curriculum
    • At least 90% of students and coaches rate new modules 4 out of 5 or higher for usefulness and real-world impact.

Key Metrics

  • Modules shipped: 2 per month.
  • Student “first wins”: At least 20% more students completing first-week tasks.
  • Faster results: Students get first interviews 7-14 days faster.
  • Student satisfaction: 90%+ rate modules highly useful.
  • Testimonials: 3+ per month from students tied to new content.
  • Founder time saved: ≤ 2 hrs/week on curriculum.

Competencies

  • Delivers on Deadlines
    • Always ships modules on time, even if imperfect at first.
    • Values progress and iteration over perfection.
  • Understands the Hiring Game
    • Knows what actually gets students hired (not just theory).
    • Filters out “fluff” and focuses on skills and steps that lead to real interviews.
  • Strong Research & Listening Skills
    • Can interview engineers, recruiters, and students to uncover gaps.
    • Turns these insights into structured training.
  • Clear Writing & Teaching Ability
    • Communicates ideas simply and logically.
    • Can create outlines and lesson flows that others (editors, designers) can polish.
  • Results-Driven Mindset
    • Always ties curriculum to measurable student progress (interviews booked, assignments completed).
  • Leadership Without Ego
    • Can coordinate freelancers (instructional designer, video editor) without being difficult to work with.
    • Takes ownership of the final product.
  • Proof-Oriented
    • Every module is designed to create a visible “win” that can be measured and turned into testimonials.
  • Protects Founder’s Time
    • Reduces reliance on the founder for content creation by handling the heavy lifting.

Cultural Fit

  • Ownership: Believes “done” means “shipped, live, and working.”
  • Practicality: Prefers useful outcomes over endless polishing.
  • Curiosity: Loves asking better questions and digging into how hiring really works.
  • Mission Alignment: Motivated by helping students land great jobs in tech.
  • Low Ego: Willing to do both strategic work and hands-on tasks.
  • Evidence-Based: Uses results and student wins to prove value.

Ideal Background

  • Has at least 3-5 years of relevant experience with one of the following:
    • Software Engineering Background: 1-3 years as a full-time SWE or intern at a real company, with experience mentoring, leading onboarding, or helping junior engineers.
    • Technical Instruction/Curriculum Experience: 2+ years designing or delivering educational content for tech (bootcamps, YouTube, online courses, etc.). Must have shipped full-length lessons or workshops with materials like worksheets, slides, videos.
    • Recruiting/Career Coaching: 2+ years as a tech recruiter, career coach, or admissions/career lead at a bootcamp or CS program, with clear understanding of what leads to real interviews and offers.
    • Former Software Engineer, Tech Recruiter, or Coding Bootcamp Instructor.
    • Experience designing or teaching training (courses, tutorials, or workshops).
    • Comfortable with structured writing and creating training outlines.
    • A portfolio of content or curriculum is a strong plus.
    • Bonus: Experience mentoring junior engineers or running interview prep.

A-Player Definition

  • Consistently ships modules on schedule.
  • New content measurably helps students land interviews faster and stay more engaged.
  • The founder’s time in product creation is reduced to a minimum.
  • Students and coaches praise the relevance of content.
  • Proof (testimonials, recruiter feedback, case studies) flows naturally.
  • Within 12 months, the business runs curriculum updates without depending on the founder.

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório de São Paulo/ Rio de Janeiro/ Porto Alegre...

hybrid

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa Gerente de Tributos você será parte da área de Tax com foco na indústria financeira, atuando em consultoria tributária, auxiliando as empresas em projetos de compliance e consultoria em impostos diretos (CSLL e IRPJ) para bancos e seguradoras, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Liderar equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação do imposto diferido e respectivas projeções de acordo com as normas ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação da apuração do imposto de renda e contribuição social seguindo as normas e legislações aplicáveis;
  • Realizar pesquisas e responder as consultas tributárias de clientes;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de trabalho produtivos com os funcionários de clientes e avaliar sua satisfação;
  • Supervisionar o trabalho de campo diário, informar aos supervisores a situação do trabalho e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Contribuir com ideias/opiniões para as equipes de impostos e ouvir/ser receptivo/a ao ponto de vista de outros membros da equipe;
  • Ter um entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e buscar/incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – lucro real e lucro presumido) e na preparação e revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Habilidade avançada na comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade no trabalho em equipe e liderança.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, compliance e planejamento Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

Quem somos:

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e, a 2a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

description:
Senior Product Manager, Data Products (Bangkok-based)

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager, Data Products (Bangkok-based) role at Agoda.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7 million hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees represent 95+ nationalities across 27 markets, fostering a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

About The Role

As a Data Product Manager, you will play a critical role in shaping and delivering data products and projects that power decision‑making, monitoring, and innovation across the business. You will define product vision, manage roadmaps, and collaborate with cross‑functional teams to build scalable, reliable, and user‑centric data solutions. Your strategic thinking and product sense will help elevate our data platform capabilities and maximize business impact through data.

What You’ll Do

Product Leadership & Strategy
  • Define clear goals, success metrics, and KPIs to measure the value and impact of data products/projects.
  • Lead the end‑to‑end lifecycle of data projects, from discovery and requirements gathering to release and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and manage the product roadmap in close collaboration with engineering, analytics, business, and product stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to create or enhance data products that solve real user problems and unlock business value.
  • Ensure alignment between product initiatives and broader business strategy.
Stakeholder Management
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all stakeholders on all things related to data and analytics.
  • Organize and gather requirements, and ensure alignment across business analysts, product teams, account managers, and partners.
  • Communicate product vision, timelines, trade‑offs, and progress effectively to technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Drive decision‑making by presenting clear data product insights, feasibility considerations, and business value assessments.
Execution & Delivery Support
  • Collaborate with data engineers and BI analysts to deliver robust data solutions (datasets, dashboards, APIs, reporting).
  • Ensure clear documentation of product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Prioritize development efforts based on impact, feasibility, and user needs.
  • Oversee data validation, testing, and release processes to ensure high‑quality delivery.
Data Governance & Quality
  • Promote data governance best practices, including consistent definitions, data lineage, and metadata management.
  • Monitor data product performance and quality post‑release, and coordinate improvements as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, privacy, and compliance standards across all data product initiatives.
Process Improvement
  • Identify and implement opportunities to streamline data product development and delivery processes.
  • Advocate for product and data best practices within cross‑functional teams.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, user‑centricity, and continuous learning in how data products are developed and used.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Proven experience in product management, ideally focused on data platforms, analytics tools, or data infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of data pipelines, data modeling, and analytics workflows.
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written), with an ability to translate complex technical concepts into business‑friendly language.
  • Proactive, analytical, and user‑focused approach to problem‑solving.
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies and product management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Trello).
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced environment and balance multiple priorities effectively.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. Esta oportunidade, apesar de ser remoto/digital é para residentes de Curitiba e região metropolitana.

Você acredita que a educação melhora o mundo? Você quer participar de uma rede de networking de mais de 4 mil executivos e 1.000 estudantes onde, além de gerar valor para sua carreira, você também contribui para educação e combate à fome? Se a resposta é sim, venha conosco!

A PUC angels (Associação Anjos da PUC) é uma associação sem fins lucrativos que busca, por meio da educação, aprimorar o ecossistema de empreendedorismo e empregabilidade no Brasil. Acreditamos que o primeiro empreendimento de uma pessoa é sua carreira profissional. Hoje, contamos com mais de 20 colaboradores diretos e uma rede de mais de 4.000 executivos e 1.000 estudantes no Programa Anjo, que também pode incluir você – com oportunidades para atuar como mentor, executivo, empreendedor e/ou investidor.

Formato do Comitê de ESG PUC angels

O cargo é voluntário e remoto, para atuar como Membro do Comitê de ESG (com possibilidade de progressão para a posição de Líder Anjo de ESG para empresas e startups interessadas). Os membros contribuem com o ecossistema da PUC angels, auxiliando fundadores de startups, executivos e estudantes no desenvolvimento e aplicação de conhecimentos, além de participar de iniciativas e comissões conforme a demanda. Os Líderes Anjo podem liderar as Iniciativas e Comissões, conforme submetem o tema e o mesmo é aprovado pelo Presidente do Comitê.

Papéis: Membro Executivo vs. Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG

Como Membro, você participa de reuniões gerais e abertas, assim como eventos, podendo sugerir temas para revisão, além de divulgar seu título de Membro do Comitê de em seu LinkedIn. Como Líder Anjo, terá a oportunidade de liderar Comissões e Iniciativas, assumir diretorias do comitê, submeter temas para avaliação da Presidência, e poderá concorrer à liderança do Comitê, participando de eventos exclusivos para Líder Anjos e outros associados.

Qualificações:

  • Interesse e paixão pelo tema do Comitê de ESG
  • Capacidade de pensar estrategicamente e aplicar conhecimentos na prática
  • Paixão por contribuir para a sociedade por meio da educação
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento
  • Habilidade de trabalho remoto e proativo
  • Envolvimento com o tema do comitê
  • Proficiência em português (inglês e espanhol são diferenciais pois a PUC angels está expandindo)
  • Paciência e habilidade para ensinar e motivar

Por que Participar como Membro ou Líder Anjo no Comitê de ESG da PUC angels?

  • Ganhe visibilidade no mercado, destacando-se como um Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG da PUC angels
  • Tenha impacto direto no ecossistema de inovação e mudanças de mercado, assumindo uma posição de liderança
  • Acrescente experiência e o título de Membro Executivo /Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG da PUC angels ao seu perfil profissional
  • Expanda seu networking com mais de 4.000 executivos, 1.000 alunos e empreendedores
  • Participe como mentor, conselheiro, investidor e/ou empreendedor dentro do ecossistema de networking da PUC angels
  • Escolha as frentes em que deseja atuar ou explore todas as oportunidades que oferecemos

Atividades do Comitê

  • Reuniões online: Sessões periódicas sobre temas de mercado e painéis com profissionais de destaque
  • Produção de artigos: Elaboração de conteúdos sobre novidades e dados de mercado
  • Regulamentações: Participação em grupos para regulamentação de iniciativas, com interação direta com executivos, empresas, governo e outras associações via PUC angels

Oportunidades Complementares

  • Possibilidade de investir em projetos já existentes
  • Sessões de pitch (online e presenciais), eventos de aceleração e parcerias estratégicas
  • Atuação como Mentor ou Conselheira Anjo para startups e estudantes

Networking e Eventos

  • Acesso a grupos exclusivos no WhatsApp e LinkedIn
  • Participação em eventos temáticos presenciais e online promovidos pela PUC angels e Comitês, em locais de destaque como a Tuca da PUC SP, Inovabra e FIEP

Objetivo dos Comitês PUC angels

Promover a evolução e integração dos mercados em que atua através do conhecimento e networking, atuando, quando necessário, na regulamentação necessária para que cada mercado cresça de forma sustentável.

Missão PUC angels

Melhorar o mundo através da educação e do combate à fome.

Objetivo do Comitê de ESG PUC angels

Promover o empreendedorismo de ESG, networking e inovação, fortalecendo empresas, ampliando a empregabilidade e gerando valor para todas as pessoas envolvidas.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

No Canal Brasil, o Marketing e Negócios são o coração da comunicação e da conexão com o público. Nossa missão é dar voz ao audiovisual brasileiro, criando pontes entre artistas, obras e espectadores em todas as plataformas.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar na Gestão de plataformas e campanhas: configuração e acompanhamento de campanhas pagas, análise de resultados e performance, envio de relatórios e monitoramento diário de tendências e oportunidades.

Requirements and skills

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação em Comunicação, Marketing, Jornalismo ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em gestão de redes sociais (planejamento, produção e publicação de conteúdo).
  • Experiência em criar e configurar campanhas de mídia paga em todas as plataformas: youtube, Fb, Inta, X e Tik Tok.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de edição básica de vídeo e imagem (ex.: Premiere, CapCut, Photoshop, Canva).
  • Experiência em análise de métricas e relatórios de performance em plataformas sociais e YouTube. Organização e gestão de fluxo de materiais (envio, adaptação e acompanhamento com equipe de edição).

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Boa redação e capacidade de criação de roteiros/pautas para conteúdos digitais e jornalísticos.
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento de tendências digitais e identificação de oportunidades de conteúdo.
  • Experiência em cobertura de eventos ao vivo (produção e publicação em tempo real).
  • Projetos pessoais contam muito (ex: perfil de conteúdo próprio, newsletter, canal, podcast, etc.)

Additional information

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.

Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação.

A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles.

Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma 100% remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo.

title: Analyst, Financial Crime Operations (LATAM Focus)
description:
Join to apply for the Analyst, Financial Crime Operations (LATAM Focus) role at Reap

Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.

Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services, from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.

Backed by leading investors including Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.

About the team

We are looking for a passionate, detail-oriented and proactive Financial Crime Operations Analyst to join our Latam Operations team. This role encompasses the full spectrum of financial crime prevention, including client onboarding and KYB screening, AML compliance, and broader financial crime risk management, ensuring we adhere to global regulatory standards.

In this role, you will drive operational excellence by streamlining onboarding and KYB processes, conducting comprehensive CDD and EDD, monitoring transactions for suspicious activities, and escalating potential fraudulent or sanction-related alerts. You will collaborate closely with compliance and regulatory teams to support risk assessments, enhance financial crime frameworks, and identify automation opportunities to streamline workflows.

You’ll be a key link between Reap Latam expansion efforts, headquarters operations, and our global compliance framework.

What You'll Do

You will own and drive end-to-end onboarding & AML operations across client lifecycle stages. Key responsibilities include:

  • Onboarding KYC/KYB Reviews: Conduct and sign off on due diligence for new and existing clients, including assessing complex corporate structures, international UBOs, and business models with higher-risk elements.
  • Periodic Reviews & Ongoing Monitoring: Lead ongoing due diligence checks and risk re-rating exercises, ensuring continued alignment with internal AML policies and evolving risk appetite.
  • Risk-Based Thinking & Data Analysis: Interpret and leverage data trends to identify potential policy gaps, process inefficiencies, or client behavioral red flags. Collaborate with analytics or product teams to refine rules and controls.
  • SOP Development, QA Involvement & Project Ownership: Drive the drafting and enhancement of SOPs, control checklists, and workflows in alignment with global AML/CTF policies. Partner with the QA team to ensure consistency and execution quality. You will also help design and implement the maker-checker (2-eye/4-eye) process, and serve as checker for escalated or sensitive cases.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in onboarding operations, due diligence, or transaction monitoring. Ideally with exposure to fintech, payments, EMIs/MSBs, cards, or regulated financial institutions. Proven end-to-end exposure to KYC/KYB and onboarding operations, with a strong track record of delivering high-quality service while meeting strict SLA standards.
  • AML Knowledge: Familiarity with global AML/CTF standards (e.g., FATF, CNBV, UIF, BCB, and other relevant Regulations in Mexico and Brazil).
  • Strategic Execution & Maker-Checker Design: Experience implementing or managing 2-eye/4-eye review frameworks, including performing the checker role on risk-sensitive cases. Experience in detecting and identifying patterns of unusual activity that lead to new types of unusual behavior.
  • Project Ownership: Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to lead and deliver small-to-medium AML projects and tasks. Comfortable coordinating across teams such as Product, Growth, Legal and Compliance, and Finance Ops.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in business English (spoken and written). Ability to read and speak Portuguese, is a strong advantage (for candidates outside Brazil).
  • Artificial Intelligence Knowledge: Experience and knowledge using AI tools is a plus.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Company Description

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

Job Description

Your Career

The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.

You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.

Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.

Your Impact

  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise‑wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS‑based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel‑centric go‑to‑market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white‑space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex‑solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self‑direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals

Additional Information

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions‑focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is an event analytics platform for builders who need answers from their data at their fingertips—no SQL required. When everyone in the organization can see and learn from the impact of their work on product, marketing, and company revenue metrics, they are poised to make better decisions.

Over 9,000 paid customers, including companies like Netflix, Pinterest, Sweetgreen, and Samsara, use Mixpanel to understand their customers and measure progress. Our commitment is to provide the most comprehensive and reliable analytics platform accessible and trusted by all.

Locations Considered

San Francisco Bay Area, San Diego, Los Angeles, Seattle, Chicago, or Austin.

About the Team

The Operational Finance Team is responsible for a variety of tasks that are instrumental in keeping the business running on a day-to-day basis. There are six teams within the Operational Finance Function each serve a specific purpose to the company: (1) Accounting and Accounts Payable - Accurately records all vendor related transactions and keeps our vendors paid, (2) AR Team - provisions all customers access to Mixpanel and ensure proper revenue recognition and records all customer payments and ensures we get paid on time, (3) Payroll - prepares payrolls for all employees world wide. (4) Deal Desk - facilitates in the contract review and execution of customer contracts and assists the sales team to accelerate the deal cycle. (5) Procurement - oversees and facilitates the source-to-pay process with an objective of efficiency and cost savings.

About the Role

Mixpanel is looking for someone to be the first tax hire, with the primary focus being indirect tax, with a heavy focus on international indirect tax. They should have strong experience with a variety of indirect and International tax operations and can drive process improvements. This person should work well independently, as well as have the ability to work well with stakeholders and communicate the benefits of tax initiatives. In this role, strong accounting, analytical, and research skills will be required, along with excellent written and oral communication skills. We are looking for an Indirect Tax Manager who will direct and manage multiple operations related to taxes while also participating in the preparation of recurring obligations. This role will manage specific indirect tax-related functions in addition to compliance-related activities and plan, manage, and develop overall aspects of the company's tax process. This role will report to the Corporate Controller.

Responsibilities

  • Facilitate and coordinate with outside tax consultants the preparation, review, and submission of all required company tax filings, including: Sales Tax, 1099, VAT/GST, withholding taxes, and other indirect taxes.
  • Manage and facilitate indirect tax-related audits and projects: preparing responses, creating schedules, reviewing memos, etc.
  • Develop and implement strategic tax planning for all necessary indirect and international taxes.
  • Plan for and develop the overall return calendar and coordinate timing and inputs with the tax team.
  • Maintain and prepare all general ledger accounts and oversee the preparation and recording of all required tax-related filings, journal entries, and reconciliations (includes Corporate Taxes).
  • Maintain effective control procedures over all aspects of the tax process.
  • Find and implement opportunities for process improvement in company tax procedures.
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory tax law developments, communicate the effects of these developments to management and the tax team, and create strategies to capitalize on changes to taxation legislation.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Extensive corporate tax knowledge, familiar with International Taxes, local and indirect taxes (both US and internationally)
  • Strong knowledge of tax code, compliance, and procedures for corporations.
  • Familiarity with Indirect taxes - U.S. and internationally.
  • Strong communication, organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • The Tax Manager must be proficient with the following software/tools: ◦ Strong skills and experience with Word, Excel.
  • Preferred candidates have a current CPA license and a master’s degree in an accounting/tax discipline.
  • We are looking for a candidate with 5+ years of experience in indirect tax manager or public accountant role.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 9,000 customers and $277M raised from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Job Summary

The Facilities Manager is responsible for overseeing the maintenance, repair, and operational efficiency of all physical assets across our quick-service restaurant locations. This role ensures that our facilities are safe, compliant with regulations, and optimized to support a positive customer and employee experience. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with strong organizational skills and a passion for operational excellence in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facility Maintenance : Oversee and coordinate routine maintenance, repairs, and inspections of restaurant facilities, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and kitchen equipment.

  • Emergency Response : Respond promptly to facility-related emergencies, such as equipment failures or structural issues, to minimize downtime and maintain operational continuity.
  • Team Collaboration : Work closely with restaurant managers and support teams to address facility needs, implement improvements, and support brand standards.
  • Preventive Maintenance Programs : Follow and implement preventive maintenance schedules to reduce equipment downtime and extend the lifespan of assets.
  • Project Management : Support facility-related projects, such as renovations, remodels, or new store openings, ensuring timely completion within budget and scope.

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in facility management, engineering, business administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Certifications : Preferred certifications include Certified Facility Manager (CFM), OSHA 30, or similar credentials in safety or facility management.
  • Soft Skills : Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills. Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Financial Acumen : Experience managing budgets and negotiating vendor contracts.
  • Availability : Willingness to travel to multiple locations and respond to emergencies outside regular business hours.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform physical inspections of facilities, including climbing ladders and accessing confined spaces.

title: Ad Tech Developer – Header Bidding
description:
At MonetizeMore, we’re all about using data to transform how the advertising industry tackles IVT (Invalid Traffic) and fraud prevention. Our products deliver real impact—and we need top-tier talent to help sell this premium AI product to better protect ad monetized publishers and ad tech vendors.

For 15 years, we’ve been driven by a team of 100+ talented professionals across the globe. As a 100% remote and culture-centric organization, we are built on the core pillars of Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen, ensuring excellence in everything we do.

About the Role

MonetizeMore is seeking an Ad Tech Developer with in-depth expertise in header bidding to build, optimize, and scale programmatic monetization for premium publishers. You’ll own end-to-end header bidding implementations (with a heavy focus on Prebid.js), improve auction performance, and partner with product, yield, and publisher success teams to deliver revenue-lifting results with excellent user experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Design & implement header bidding stacks using Prebid.js (web) and related wrappers; configure bidders, floors, price granularity, userId modules, and analytics.
  • Customize & extend adapters/modules (e.g., userId, analytics, consent) and contribute clean, documented JavaScript/TypeScript code.
  • Integrate with GAM/Ad Manager (GPT): line item strategy, key-values, creative templates, and troubleshooting of delivery and competition.
  • Optimize auctions & latency: tune timeouts, s2s vs. client, floors, ad refresh logic, and page performance (CLS/LCP/INP/Core Web Vitals).
  • Run experiments: A/B test bidders, formats, and page placements; build dashboards to track impact (e.g., eCPM, viewability, fill, latency).
  • Debug complex issues across browser, network, and auction layers (DevTools, HAR/Waterfall, Charles/Proxyman); resolve revenue dips & bidder errors.
  • Implement privacy & compliance: IAB TCF, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, CMP integration, consent storage, and geo-specific behaviors.
  • Work with partners: SSPs, exchanges, ID providers, and analytics vendors to launch new demand and troubleshoot.
  • Ship quality safely: use Git, CI/CD, code review, and observability to keep releases fast and reliable.
  • Document & mentor: write clear runbooks and help level up teammates.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–6+ years of front-end or full-stack experience with a strong JavaScript foundation (TypeScript a plus).
  • 2–4+ years hands-on with header bidding (Prebid.js required); experience with s2s/managed wrappers (e.g., Prebid Server, Amazon TAM/UAM) is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM/GPT) setups, line items & creatives, key-values, targeting, and delivery debugging.
  • Working knowledge of programmatic concepts: OpenRTB, floors, auction dynamics, user sync/ID, brand safety, and viewability.
  • Familiarity with privacy frameworks & CMPs (IAB TCF v2.x, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA) and consent-aware ad serving.
  • Performance tuning for Core Web Vitals and modern build tools (Webpack/Vite/Rollup).
  • Comfort with Chrome DevTools, network waterfalls, and log-driven debugging; bonus points for Node.js, Cloud Functions, or simple backend endpoints.
  • Data fluency: basic SQL or BI tools (Looker/Data Studio/BigQuery) for revenue & latency analysis.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; bias for automation and measurable outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with app/webview monetization, AMP, or SPA frameworks (React/Vue/Svelte).
  • Prebid analytics adapters or custom reporting pipelines.
  • Experience with ads.txt/app-ads.txt, sellers.json, supply chain object.
  • Knowledge of brand safety & IVT controls, creative QA, and MRC viewability standards.
  • Exposure to video (IMA/OMSDK, Prebid Video, VAST/VPAID/VMAP) or CTV/OTT.
  • Knowledge in Python and NoSQL is a plus.

Why MonetizeMore

  • Remote-first culture with flexible work hours.
  • Impact at scale across a large publisher network.
  • Smart, low-ego teammates and a culture of experimentation.
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, home-office stipend, and learning budget.

Please click HERE to visit the careers site, to learn more about working for Greenpeace.

About us

Greenpeace is a global campaigning network. It comprises 26 independent national/regional organisations, and a coordinating organisation, Greenpeace International. Greenpeace uses peaceful, creative confrontation to expose global environmental problems, and develop solutions for a green and peaceful future.

Our goal is to ensure the ability of the earth to nurture life in all its diversity. That means we want to:

  • protect biodiversity in all its forms
  • prevent pollution and abuse of the earth’s ocean, land, air and fresh water
  • end all nuclear threats
  • promote peace, global disarmament and non-violence

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshooting issues.
  • Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment).

Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
About Higlobe

We are an international payment platform that moves money instantly and with zero transaction fees. Our product is specifically designed for international professionals; overseas freelancers, contractors, and independent workers with US business clients. We understand that having an easy payment method can bring more jobs and opportunities for international workers with a global mindset.

We are a fully remote team with members working across various countries, all coming together to create an amazing product to support international companies and professionals.

About the Sales Development Representative (SDR) Role

Higlobe is seeking a qualified sales development representative (SDR) to find and screen potential customers who could benefit from our products and services. As the first line of communication with a prospect, the ideal SDR has a strong understanding of the sales process and excels at researching leads, starting new relationships, and closing new accounts. The SDR should be a quick learner who has strong communication skills and an ability to showcase our offerings in a compelling way. Every potential customer is an opportunity for boosting top-line revenue growth, customer acquisition levels, and profitability.

This person will work normal business hours in Brazil but will need to offer flexibility as the Higlobe team has members in 15 countries.

What You’ll Do

  • Represent the company’s products and services, using comprehensive knowledge as well as consumer research to explain how our solutions meet customer needs
  • Generate leads and build relationships by nurturing warm prospects and finding potential new sales opportunities
  • Manage and maintain a pipeline of interested prospects and engage sales executives in next steps
  • Identify best practices for refining the company’s lead-generation playbook
  • Utilize Salesloft, cold calls, and email to generate new sales opportunities
  • Identify the needs of prospects, and suggest appropriate products or services
  • Build long-term, trusting relationships with prospects to qualify leads as sales opportunities
  • Proactively seek new business opportunities in the market
  • Set up meetings or calls between (prospective) customers and sales executives
  • Manage and support both new and existing accounts, ensuring a high level of service and client satisfaction.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in sales, with a track record of exceeding lead targets
  • Experience selling into BPOs, call centers, or other freelance networks
  • Experience with fintech, payments, or other financial services
  • English Proficiency both verbal and written
  • Strong communication skills via phone and email
  • Proven, creative problem-solving approach and strong analytical skills
  • Strong desire and ability to move up within a sales organization
  • Experience as a sales development representative, with a track record of achieving sales quotas
  • Proficiency with Salesloft or other CRM software
  • Conduct regular client visits (in-person or virtual) to build strong relationships, better understand client needs, and offer Higlobe solutions for businesses

If you think you’d be a good fit for this role, even if you may not meet all of the requirements, we’d love for you to apply! At Higlobe, we strive to create an inclusive culture that encourages people from different backgrounds to bring their unique, diverse perspectives to work. We aim every day to build an environment that empowers us all to do our best work.

Perks

  • Global, fully remote company
  • Unlimited time off

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

description:
Job description

Sobre a Clicksign

Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em assinaturas eletrônicas. Em essência, facilitamos relações entre pessoas e empresas no ambiente digital. Por trás da nossa tecnologia de ponta e foco em segurança, temos a missão de fazer o mundo crescer, tornando as relações digitais cada vez mais inteligentes.

Como trabalhamos:

Nossa essência é o Trust. Trabalhamos com foco, ritmo, comunicação clara e dados para nos apoiar. Trabalhamos com capricho; colocamos cuidado e qualidade em tudo que fazemos. Empatia e respeito são pilares da nossa equipe.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Data Analyst para atuar como referência analítica da Value Stream de Aquisição e Ativação , unindo rigor técnico e visão de negócio para escalar receita de novos clientes e aumentar a conversão e engajamento inicial.

Será responsável por traduzir dados em estratégias de crescimento previsível, apoiar decisões de marketing e produto e garantir que os novos clientes avancem com sucesso na jornada de ativação.

Esse papel exige perfil híbrido entre marketing analytics e produto analytics, com alta capacidade de transformar dados em narrativas acionáveis para times executivos e squads.

Main responsibilities

  • Mapear, mensurar e otimizar o funil completo de aquisição (leads → trial → subscription → ativação);
  • Analisar e priorizar gargalos de conversão e fricção de jornada, propondo hipóteses e recomendações práticas;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar experimentos (A/B tests) em páginas de planos, checkout e onboarding, medindo impacto em conversão e receita;
  • Conduzir análises de comportamento de trial e ativação (cohorts, time-to-convert, first value moment, early churn);
  • Apoiar na avaliação de performance de campanhas, canais e ICPs;
  • Produzir relatórios executivos e narrativas de performance para comitês estratégicos e diretoria;
  • Construir dashboards e métricas padronizadas (Leads, Conversão, Ticket Médio, Early Churn, NMRR);
  • Apoiar na evolução da jornada inicial, priorizando testes e insights que aumentem engajamento nos primeiros 90 dias;
  • Garantir qualidade e consistência das métricas, em parceria com Analytics Engineering e Data Engineering;
  • Disseminar práticas data-driven dentro da VS, formando stakeholders mais autônomos e conscientes de métricas.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em análises de funil, experimentação e growth analytics;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em estatística descritiva e inferencial (testes de hipótese, causalidade, regressão, cohort analysis);
  • Experiência prática com SQL e linguagens de análise (Python ou R);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de BI (QuickSight, Looker, Metabase, Tableau, etc.);
  • Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Habilidade de traduzir resultados técnicos em recomendações de negócio para públicos não técnicos;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de influência e visão integrada entre marketing e produto;
  • Proatividade para propor hipóteses e conduzir análises ponta a ponta, com senso de urgência e ownership.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em Marketing Analytics, Growth ou Produto;
  • Vivência em ambientes SaaS ou negócios de recorrência;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de tracking e experimentação (ex: PostHog, Segment, Amplitude, GA4);
  • Conhecimento de modelagem de propensão à conversão ou ativação (logistic regression, random forest, etc.);
  • Experiência com A/B testing e métodos causais (Diff-in-Diff, Uplift Modeling, PSM);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e automação (HubSpot, RD, Salesforce, etc.);
  • Capacidade de construir storytelling com dados e influenciar decisões estratégicas.

Additional information

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Cultura de confiança, focada em resultados e com muito desafio e aprendizado.
  • Autonomia e protagonismo, em um ambiente cheio de colaboração e empatia.
  • Cultura de feedback e 1:1 com uma liderança humana e sem microgerenciamento.
  • Benefícios completos como: vale refeição/alimentação, auxílios creche, home office, saúde, educação e cultura, gympass, day-off de aniversário, descontos em terapia e cursos de inglês, entre outras parcerias.

description:
Esta oportunidade, apesar de ser remoto/digital é para residentes de Goiâniae região metropolitana.

Você acredita que a educação melhora o mundo? Você quer participar de uma rede de networking de mais de 4 mil executivos e 1.000 estudantes onde, além de gerar valor para sua carreira, você também contribui para educação e combate à fome? Se a resposta é sim, venha conosco!

A PUC angels (Associação Anjos da PUC) é uma associação sem fins lucrativos que busca, por meio da educação, aprimorar o ecossistema de empreendedorismo e empregabilidade no Brasil. Acreditamos que o primeiro empreendimento de uma pessoa é sua carreira profissional. Hoje, contamos com mais de 20 colaboradores diretos e uma rede de mais de 4.000 executivos e 1.000 estudantes no Programa Anjo, que também pode incluir você – com oportunidades para atuar como mentor, executivo, empreendedor e/ou investidor.

Formato do Comitê de ESG PUC angels

O cargo é voluntário e remoto, para atuar como Membro do Comitê de ESG (com possibilidade de progressão para a posição de Líder Anjo de ESG para empresas e startups interessadas). Os membros contribuem com o ecossistema da PUC angels, auxiliando fundadores de startups, executivos e estudantes no desenvolvimento e aplicação de conhecimentos, além de participar de iniciativas e comissões conforme a demanda. Os Líderes Anjo podem liderar as Iniciativas e Comissões, conforme submetem o tema e o mesmo é aprovado pelo Presidente do Comitê.

Papéis: Membro Executivo vs. Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG

Como Membro, você participa de reuniões gerais e abertas, assim como eventos, podendo sugerir temas para revisão, além de divulgar seu título de Membro do Comitê de em seu LinkedIn. Como Líder Anjo, terá a oportunidade de liderar Comissões e Iniciativas, assumir diretorias do comitê, submeter temas para avaliação da Presidência, e poderá concorrer à liderança do Comitê, participando de eventos exclusivos para Líder Anjos e outros associados.

Qualificações:

  • Interesse e paixão pelo tema do Comitê de ESG
  • Capacidade de pensar estrategicamente e aplicar conhecimentos na prática
  • Paixão por contribuir para a sociedade por meio da educação
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento
  • Habilidade de trabalho remoto e proativo
  • Envolvimento com o tema do comitê
  • Proficiência em português (inglês e espanhol são diferenciais pois a PUC angels está expandindo)
  • Paciência e habilidade para ensinar e motivar

Por que Participar como Membro ou Líder Anjo no Comitê de ESG da PUC angels?

  • Ganhe visibilidade no mercado, destacando-se como um Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG da PUC angels
  • Tenha impacto direto no ecossistema de inovação e mudanças de mercado, assumindo uma posição de liderança
  • Acrescente experiência e o título de Membro Executivo /Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG da PUC angels ao seu perfil profissional
  • Expanda seu networking com mais de 4.000 executivos, 1.000 alunos e empreendedores
  • Participe como mentor, conselheiro, investidor e/ou empreendedor dentro do ecossistema de networking da PUC angels
  • Escolha as frentes em que deseja atuar ou explore todas as oportunidades que oferecemos

Atividades do Comitê

  • Reuniões online: Sessões periódicas sobre temas de mercado e painéis com profissionais de destaque
  • Produção de artigos: Elaboração de conteúdos sobre novidades e dados de mercado
  • Regulamentações: Participação em grupos para regulamentação de iniciativas, com interação direta com executivos, empresas, governo e outras associações via PUC angels

Oportunidades Complementares

  • Possibilidade de investir em projetos já existentes
  • Sessões de pitch (online e presenciais), eventos de aceleração e parcerias estratégicas
  • Atuação como Mentor ou Conselheira Anjo para startups e estudantes

Networking e Eventos

  • Acesso a grupos exclusivos no WhatsApp e LinkedIn
  • Participação em eventos temáticos presenciais e online promovidos pela PUC angels e Comitês, em locais de destaque como a Tuca da PUC SP, Inovabra e FIEP

Objetivo dos Comitês PUC angels

Promover a evolução e integração dos mercados em que atua através do conhecimento e networking, atuando, quando necessário, na regulamentação necessária para que cada mercado cresça de forma sustentável.

Missão PUC angels

Melhorar o mundo através da educação e do combate à fome.

Objetivo do Comitê de ESG PUC angels

Promover o empreendedorismo de ESG, networking e inovação, fortalecendo empresas, ampliando a empregabilidade e gerando valor para todas as pessoas envolvidas.

description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way

Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. About JLL

We’re JLL. We’re a professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We help organizations around the world achieve their ambitions by owning, occupying and investing in real estate.

We’re a Fortune 500 company. We work across 80 countries, in 280 different offices, with a team of over 92,000 individuals. And we look after a property portfolio of over 4bn square feet, all on behalf of our clients.

If you’re looking to step up your career, JLL is the perfect professional home. At JLL, you’ll have a chance to innovate with the world’s leading businesses, put that expertise into action on landmark projects, and work on game‑changing real estate initiatives. You’ll also make long‑lasting professional connections through sharing different perspectives, and you’ll be inspired by the best. We’re focused on opportunity and want to help you make the most of yours. Achieve your ambitions – join us at JLL! JLLT has an ambition to deliver $1 billion in revenue, Sourcing and Procurement is a key component of helping to support this strategic goal.

About JLL Technologies

JLL has a global IT function which spends over $500 million per annum. The role entails working with JLLT leadership team to develop key strategies that help to fully leverage expenditure, build an enterprise operating model that helps JLLT achieves its goals, manage risk, consider balance of trade considerations and how expenditure can be evolved further. All sourcing and procurement needs to be done against the backdrop of JLL governance and S&P guidelines.

Global Category Manager – Software

Develop, manage and execute global category sourcing strategies within the specific IT Category allocated. As the Software Category Manager you will be responsible for building relationships with the CIO’s, CTO’s, Chief Product Officers, building internal demand plans, developing category plans including new opportunities and manage relationships with key strategic suppliers. Ensure contracting and procurement standards are maintained throughout the portfolio.

Summary of essential functions and Goals

  • Partner with the JLLT leadership team to create category strategies that align with JLLT’s key fundamental plans whilst leveraging growing expenditure to have commercial advantage

  • Develops & regularly maintains/up‑dates short-, mid- and long‑term category strategy globally, linking this strategy with overall business strategy/objectives, in alignment with departmental stakeholders (C‑suite)

  • Category Manager has and/or forges key strategic relationships with (strategic) suppliers/industry leaders and develops those relationships on behalf of JLL being mindful of long‑term mutually beneficial and ethical objectives as well as providing the business with access to supplier innovation

  • Category Manager is responsible for leading the approval process for third party expenditure. This includes presenting the deal to senior leaders in the business such as the JLLT CEO, Global CFO and Global CPO

  • Category Manager is leading key strategic procurement projects and provides expert advice and guidance to the JLLT leadership team. Advice has expanded from pricing and commercial principles to incorporate aligning supplier/partner strategies to make/buy decisions & managing sensitivities where JLL’s strategy could create direct conflict against the suppliers value proposition

  • The Category Manager will recommend the qualification of appropriate service providers/supply partners to ensure that we have the best service provision available across the region to deliver value to our internal and sometimes also external clients

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for global category strategy development, execution and category performance of all category related activities & objectives for corporate category requirements as well as other JLL entities if required. Ensuring alignment across the JLLT Leadership team

  • Delivery of financial targets in line with business expectations. Category Manager continuously drives the category opportunity agenda and self‑sufficiently identifies, agrees and executes these projects

  • Accountable for creating strategic solution for specific commodity/service requirements, procurement event planning, RFP/quotation management, bid analysis and recommendations, liaison with internal stakeholders for contract approvals, savings reporting, documentation and compliance.

  • Create and manage the category project calendar, lead category events, bid process, commercial evaluation, recommendations, contract document preparation and functional reviews

  • Approvals according to JLL Delegation of Authority. Compliance with JLL procedures as applicable. This includes presenting and seeking approval from Global CEO of JLLT, Global CPO and Global CFO

  • Rationalizes supply base and develops clear strategic supply partner framework and maintains this framework at senior supplier level

  • Use Global, Regional and Country, market and industry intelligence to identify and qualify new suppliers and use data to support the business and delivery of services. In addition, identify risk, threats and provide solutions for mitigation.

  • Provide functional leadership and peer group alignment, where appropriate and needed

  • Identify opportunities to develop and implement new policies and procedures, including rationalization of legacy policies and procedures

  • Actively engage in and support the use of e‑procurement strategy, methodology and deployment

  • Prepare high quality papers and presentations for use with internal and external stakeholders and/or teams as required

  • Apply ethical company standards and ensure Global Procurement policy is applied at all times

Ability to Manage the Sourcing Process

  • Develop category plan with the ability to provide visibility such as supplier summaries, stakeholder engagement plans, contract summaries, and market insights that lead to both short and long‑term strategies

  • Ability to negotiate and have proven strategies within areas of corporate spend

  • Lead development and execution of all sourcing‑related functions: performing due diligence and assessment of prospective suppliers, executing RFPs/bids, negotiating contracts and ensuring effective transition to operations during implementation

  • Partner with CIO’s and the business to drive both immediate and sustained benefits to JLL Corporate

  • Bring strategic thought leadership to identify additional cost and operational efficiencies. Individual must be able to consider bigger picture goals and scenarios. The individual has to be able to clearly articulate and advise senior members of JLL on decisions that could impact business line performance

  • Proactively manage internal stakeholder expectations and escalation at appropriate times

  • Savings – working with sourcing managers and key suppliers, ensure that savings initiatives ideas are being driven to maximize savings impacts

  • Ensure that the savings tracker across country is kept up‑to‑date for the category so that we can demonstrate value add to our internal stakeholders

  • Conduct Preferred Supplier performance review meetings, manage supplier scorecards, contract compliance and service obligations

  • Subject matter expert for category and considered to be the channel of choice within JLL

Sound like you? To apply you need to have:

  • Excellent Inter‑personal skills, Organization skills, Strong gravitas and influencing skills with senior business leaders

  • Ability work on a global scale and across different regions. This includes the ability to meet and align category plans with global vertical stakeholders

  • Excellent communication skills – oral and written

  • Proven ability to facilitate strategic supplier relationships and work with senior business executives and across procurement leadership

  • Collaborative and influencing style with a focus on team work

  • Proven ability to deliver results in challenging environments

  • Expertise in sourcing with demonstrated ability to manage change

  • Ability to sell and present initiatives and/or new ideas

  • Experience in sourcing indirect corporate services and products

  • Excellent PC skills, proficient in MS applications with excellent ability to work with large amounts of data and build reports

  • Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) from four‑year college university

  • Minimum 7 years of strategic sourcing experience (majority within IT and technology)

  • CPSM certification preferred

  • MBA preferred

Location

  • Role to be based in North America (USA or Canada)

  • As part of the role, individuals must have the flexibility to deal with projects in different time zones and manage their time accordingly

What you can expect from us

You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like‑minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.

Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay. We’ll offer you a competitive salary and benefits package.

Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sights and imagine where JLL can take you…

Apply today!

title: QA Lead (100% Remote)
description:
About the Job
QA Lead is responsible for overseeing the quality assurance function across Tether Data. This role ensures that product releases meet defined quality standards through the development and execution of test strategies, frameworks, and automation. QA Lead works closely with the teams, Dev‑Ops and Product to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.
QA Lead serves as the quality champion within Tether Data and plays a key role in shaping the overall testing culture and processes.

Responsibilities

  • Define and Drive QA Strategy: Establish and continuously refine the overall QA vision, goals, and strategy to align with product and engineering objectives, balancing manual and automated testing approaches.
  • Plan and Manage Testing Activities: Oversee test planning, prioritization, and execution across projects. Ensure test coverage aligns with business impact, release timelines, and risk assessment.
  • Mentor and Guide QA Engineers: Provide technical and procedural guidance to QA Engineers, fostering skill development in both manual and automation testing. Conduct regular reviews and coaching sessions.
  • Ensure Quality Governance and Standards: Define QA processes, templates, and best practices to standardize testing across teams. Maintain consistency in documentation, defect management, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with product managers, developers, and DevOps to ensure quality is embedded throughout the SDLC. Participate in planning and other ceremonies where applicable to provide support and guidance.
  • Oversee Test Automation Strategy: Guide the design, maintenance, and optimization of automation frameworks. Ensure automation coverage is effective, scalable, and well-integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Test Environments and Data: Coordinate environment setup, data preparation, and version control to ensure test consistency and reliability across manual and automated executions.
  • Monitor and Report on Quality Metrics: Define and track key QA KPIs (e.g., defect density, test coverage, pass rate, release readiness). Use insights to drive continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate Release Readiness and Risk Assessment: Lead go/no‑go decisions based on test outcomes, quality metrics, and known issues. Communicate quality status and risks clearly to stakeholders.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Evaluate tools, processes, and team performance to identify opportunities for efficiency and quality enhancement. Champion a culture of learning and proactive defect prevention.
  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.
  • 3+ years of proven experience leading QA teams or managing QA processes across multiple projects.
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java, C#).
  • Proven experience in leading the design and execution of QA strategies across multiple projects.
  • Strong proficiency in planning, scheduling, prioritizing, and coordinating testing activities across teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud environments and containerization (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Certifications: ISTQB Advanced Level, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent QA leadership certification
