description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

At IP House, we empower brands, legal professionals, and rights holders to manage and protect intellectual property—both online and offline—on a truly global scale. Through cutting‑edge technology and deep cross‑border expertise, we deliver scalable, end‑to‑end solutions for IP portfolio management, enforcement, and content and brand protection.

Overview of the Role

As a Standards and Compliance Auditor, you will provide specialized auditing services to internationally recognized organizations, ensuring adherence to stringent industry standards. Initially, you will work as part of the auditing team, with the expectation of progressing to Lead Auditor following a comprehensive familiarization and training period. This high‑profile role requires direct engagement with industry experts and the coordination of audits for participating companies worldwide. Audits typically range from 3–5 days and encompass a diverse set of subjects reviewed against defined international standards. At the conclusion of each audit, you will deliver both a verbal presentation of findings and a detailed written report outlining audit results, areas of compliance, and recommendations for improvement. This position offers the opportunity for extensive international experience, with global travel typically in business class and four‑star accommodation provided.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive audits in line with international standards, industry regulations, and company policies.
  • Engage directly with industry stakeholders to assess and verify compliance within relevant frameworks.
  • Prepare and deliver detailed audit reports, including executive summaries and risk assessments, and present findings professionally in both written and verbal formats.
  • Coordinate with international teams and organizations to schedule and execute audits efficiently.
  • Ensure audits are conducted within established timeframes and deliverables are met.
  • Provide actionable recommendations to clients on areas for improvement and compliance enhancements.
  • Stay updated on the latest compliance regulations, security standards, and industry best practices.
  • Work collaboratively within a team while also demonstrating the ability to lead and manage audit projects.

What You’ll Bring

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and methodical professional with expertise in auditing management systems based on international standards. Experience within the telecommunications industry, manufacturing processes, or information security audits will be considered an advantage.

  • Candidates must have work authorization in the country for which they are applying, without employer‑provided visa sponsorship.
  • 5+ years of experience in IT audit, compliance, or relevant fields.
  • Understanding of Information Technology compliance, including GSMA Security Accreditation Scheme (SAS), Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), SIM card or scratch card manufacturing, ISO security policies.
  • Experience auditing manufacturing processes and controls is beneficial.
  • Certification preferred: CISA, CISM, CISSP, CIPP, ISO27001 Lead Auditor.
  • Strong working knowledge of Windows/Active Directory environments; high proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Experience with security risk management methodologies, physical and logical security, production management, HR policies, disaster recovery/business continuity, networking controls, and encryption tools.
  • Familiarity with Windows and Linux/UNIX security protocols.
  • Valid driver’s license, passport, and ability to obtain a criminal clearance certificate.
  • Fluent in English; strong analytical, problem‑solving, organizational, time‑management, communication, teamwork, leadership, and proactive attitude skills.
  • CTIPS Certification preferred.

Additional Information

  • Travel: Willingness and ability to travel internationally on short notice for periods of up to 14 consecutive days.

Why IP House

IP House is redefining how the world combats illicit trade and intellectual property theft—delivering scalable, end‑to‑end solutions that empower global brands and rights holders through innovation, strategic expertise, and a relentless commitment to global enforcement. We believe our people are the foundation of everything we do and invest accordingly. From day one, we foster a culture rooted in continuous learning, professional growth, and shared excellence. We also offer a flexible work environment and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well‑being, and financial security of our employees and their families.

IP House is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering a respectful, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.

description:
Job description

Você irá exercer um papel de extrema importância no crescimento da doc9 como Product Manager Senior.

A doc9 é uma lawtech com marca consolidada no mercado jurídico com seus serviços de marketplace (cálculos, audiências e outras diligências) e que cresce em ritmo exponencial com produtos puramente tecnológicos (SaaS), como o Whom.doc9 e o eHealth.doc9.

Somos formados por gente inquieta e empreendedora, que valoriza o trabalho em equipe e acredita que o crescimento sustentável se dá a partir de pessoas que amam o que fazem.

Estamos em busca de pessoas engajadas, que tenham brilho no olho e muita vontade de se desenvolver e crescer com a gente.

Main responsibilities

Como Product Manager Sênior você atuará em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto, desde a descoberta com usuários até a entrega de soluções com alto padrão visual. Você será parte essencial do nosso time de Produto, contribuindo estrategicamente com decisões de experiência, facilitando descobertas e garantindoconsistência visual nos produtos digitais. Dentro da sua rotina estará:

  • Construir a visão e estratégia do produto de integrações, conectando objetivos de negócio à experiência dos usuários e às capacidades técnicas do ecossistema doc9;
  • Conduzir processos de discovery e validação de hipóteses, com base em entrevistas, análises de dados, benchmarks e experimentos rápidos;
  • Desenhar e priorizar o roadmap do produto, equilibrando entregas estruturantes e incrementais, com foco em escalabilidade, segurança e performance;
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs de sucesso (adoção, ativação, retenção, uso e impacto no tempo médio de operação entre sistemas);
  • Colaborar com engenharia e arquitetura de sistemas para garantir viabilidade técnica, qualidade e reusabilidade dos componentes;
  • Orquestrar integrações entre produtos internos e externos, conectando APIs, automações e fluxos de dados entre diferentes plataformas;
  • Promover cultura de produto e discovery contínuo, elevando o padrão de entrega e aprendizado no time;
  • Influenciar decisões estratégicas junto à liderança, apoiando com dados, narrativas e visão de longo prazo.

Requirements and skills

Para ser o nosso novo talento você precisa ter:

  • Mentalidade de criador , e não apenas de operador: alguém que constrói bases sólidas e pensa o produto como um negócio;
  • Capacidade de navegar na incerteza com clareza , equilibrando autonomia e alinhamento;
  • Curiosidade genuína e vontade de entender profundamente o problema antes de propor soluções;
  • Empatia, escuta ativa e paixão por criar experiências que simplificam o complexo;
  • Desejo de fazer parte de um time que está redefinindo o futuro digital do mercado jurídico ;
  • Excelente habilidade de priorização, comunicação e liderança colaborativa ;
  • Alta autonomia, mentalidade empreendedora e forte senso de dono (ownership) ;

E os seguintes conhecimentos e experiências:

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager em produtos SaaS ou plataformas B2B , com foco em integrações, APIs, automações ou low-code/no-code ;
  • Histórico comprovado de atuação em novos produtos ou MVPs (do zero à escala), com capacidade de construir frameworks e processos desde o início;
  • Domínio de métodos de discovery (entrevistas, mapeamento de dores, JTBD, experimentação);
  • Vivência em definição e acompanhamento de métricas de produto , como DAU/MAU, churn, adoção e LTV;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e gestão de backlog e roadmap;
  • Experiência prévia com ferramentas de automação (N8N, Zapier, Make, Workato, entre outras);
  • Noções de arquitetura orientada a eventos e plataformas modulares ;
  • Conhecimento em segurança e governança de dados (LGPD, autenticação, 2FA, tokens);
  • Vivência com monitoramento de performance e observabilidade (Datadog, New Relic, Grafana);
  • Interesse em inteligência artificial aplicada a automações jurídicas ;
  • Perfil data-driven , com domínio de ferramentas de análise de produto (Amplitude, Metabase, Looker, GA4);
  • Fluência em trabalho colaborativo e gestão cross‑functional , com influência sem autoridade formal.

Ferramentas, Tecnologias e Linguagens Necessárias:

  • Gestão de produto e backlog: Jira, Confluence, Linear ou ClickUp;
  • Mapeamento e discovery colaborativo: Miro ou FigJam;
  • Métricas e insights de uso: Metabase, Amplitude ou GA4;
  • Testes e documentação de APIs (diferencial): Postman, Swagger ou Insomnia;
  • Conceitos técnicos (diferencial): JSON, APIs REST, Webhooks e Tokens.

  • 100% remoto;

  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively.
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, data enrichment tools, automated workflows) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

By practicing intentional thought partnership and close collaboration, you’ll build strong, trusting relationships that ensure our clients feel heard, supported, and set up for success. Role Overview

As a Sr. Paid Social Acquisition Specialist , you will be a senior-level expert driving full-funnel paid social media strategies to fuel our clients’ growth. You’ll execute and optimize campaigns across major social platforms, ensuring they meet and exceed performance targets while aligning with broader marketing initiatives. With your strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and results-driven approach, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate creative, retention, and conversion rate optimization efforts into cohesive campaigns.

This role offers a clear path to leadership – you’ll work alongside our Paid Media Manager (PMM) to accomplish key business objectives and initiatives, positioning yourself for future growth into roles like Paid Media Manager. If you’re a data-savvy, innovative marketer passionate about leveraging AI and rapid experimentation to scale DTC brands, this opportunity is your next big challenge.

Key Responsibilities

  • Paid Social Campaign Execution & Optimization: Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns across platforms (e.g., Facebook/Instagram, TikTok) to drive customer acquisition and retention. Implement audience segmentation, targeting, messaging, and bidding strategies, continuously A/B testing creatives and audience approaches to maximize engagement and conversions. Ensure all campaigns align with client goals and WKND’s performance benchmarks for measurable outcomes.
  • Full-Funnel Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align paid social initiatives with broader direct-to-consumer growth strategies, ensuring a cohesive full-funnel approach from prospecting to retention. Work closely with creative, email/SMS, conversion rate optimization, SEO, and content teams to integrate campaign efforts and share insights. Ensure consistent messaging and leverage cross-channel learnings to improve marketing efficiency and customer lifetime value.
  • Data Analysis & KPI Management: Leverage advanced analytics platforms and AI-driven tools to monitor campaign performance and inform optimizations. Track and analyze key metrics – including return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), marketing efficiency ratio (MER), click-through rate (CTR), average order value (AOV), and CAC-to-LTV ratio – adjusting budgets and strategy to exceed targets. Use data-driven insights to make timely optimizations that improve ROI and scale results.
  • Insightful Reporting & Presentations: Compile and present detailed performance reports that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Create visually compelling presentations for internal teams and clients, highlighting campaign results, trends, and strategic recommendations. Communicate the story behind the numbers, enabling informed decision-making and demonstrating the value of our paid social efforts.

Help maintain transparent, trusting relationships by ensuring clients understand campaign progress and value.
  • Strategic Initiative Execution: Partner with the PMM to execute key business initiatives and special projects in paid media. Translate high-level objectives into actionable campaign plans and take ownership of their successful implementation. Proactively contribute ideas and optimizations that drive business goals, demonstrating leadership potential and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Who You Are

  • AI-Driven Innovator: You’re passionate about leveraging AI and automation to push the limits of what's possible, always looking for ways to deliver scalable, cutting-edge solutions that drive success.
  • Tech Visionary: You thrive in environments that challenge you to innovate, embracing new technologies and harnessing them to create transformative, future-proof SaaS platforms.

  • Collaborative Team Player: You excel in communicating complex ideas clearly, working seamlessly across teams, and contributing to a culture of open collaboration to achieve ambitious goals.
  • Results-Oriented & Data-Driven: You’re obsessed with data, continuously interpreting metrics to relentlessly optimize campaigns and drive unparalleled ROI. You’re not just meeting targets—you’re exceeding them.
  • Platform Proficiency & Digital Mastery: You’re a wizard across paid platforms like Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, and more, with a sharp understanding of AI-driven optimization tools that push performance to new heights.
  • Proactive & Adaptable: You’re always ahead of the curve, staying on top of platform changes and anticipating challenges before they arise. You pivot with agility, turning potential obstacles into growth opportunities

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field (required) .
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience in paid social (required) , with a deep understanding of paid acquisition and media buying strategies. Proven ability to scale campaigns, manage substantial budgets, and consistently meet or exceed key performance targets.
  • Technical Skills: Highly knowledgeable in bidding and targeting automation tools; proficient in Google Analytics and other ad management/testing platforms.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent project management and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to structure complex, multi-stakeholder projects effectively. Strong written and verbal communication skills for both client-facing and internal collaboration.
  • Performance Culture: Thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and effective time-management.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Base Salary: Calibrated to attract top talent who thrive under high expectations.

  • Healthcare & Wellness Options (available upon request): Designed to support your well-being and peace of mind.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Work remotely or in-office, as long as you meet deadlines and deliver exceptional results.

Ready to Shape the Future of Paid Acquisition & Paid Social — And Revolutionize with AI?

Join WKND as a Senior Paid Social Acquisition Specialist and become a pivotal force behind high-performing, AI-enhanced campaigns for top DTC brands. You won’t just execute ads—you’ll help shape strategy, pioneer new approaches in paid social, and contribute to our bold shift toward an AI-driven SaaS model.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Escalation Leadership

Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues

Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution

Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers

Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling

Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate

Expedite Resolution

Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations

Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues

Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it

Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner

Communication and Reporting

Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties

Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO

Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications

Risk Management

Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place

A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success

Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives

Retrospective and Preventive Measures

Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product

Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems

Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas

Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address

Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal

Customer Experience

10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles

Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired

Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators

Program / Project management

Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues

Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer

Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like

Collaboration and Influence

Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts

Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers

Leadership and communication skills

Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals

Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)

Technical skills

Experience with Networking / Security Products

Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures

Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues

Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations

Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties

Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility

Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives

Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account

Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

Additional Information

The Team

The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Falando sobre o Flamengo...

Que tal trabalhar em um clube de futebol referência em gestão?

Após um árduo trabalho de reestruturação, o Clube de Regatas do Flamengo tornou-se uma das marcas de maior credibilidade no cenário nacional, atraindo grandes parceiros comerciais e investindo pesado em infraestrutura e recursos humanos. Aqui a gente procura os melhores craques para todas as modalidades - inclusive nos setores administrativos! Dos mais jovens talentos com sede de aprendizado aos profissionais mais gabaritados e experientes para gerir nossas equipes, aqui tem espaço para todos, de todas as cores, crenças e gêneros.

Venha ser um dos craques do maior clube poliesportivo do Brasil!

O Flamengo é a maior marca de futebol e o maior clube poliesportivo da América Latina. Conhecido por ter a Maior Torcida do Mundo, com mais de 48 milhões de rubro-negros apaixonados espalhados pelo mundo, foi fundado em 1895 e, desde então, coleciona títulos em diversas modalidades esportivas ao longo de sua história centenária. No futebol, carro-chefe do clube, o Flamengo é octacampeão brasileiro, pentacampeão da Copa do Brasil, maior vencedor do Campeonato Carioca com 39 títulos, tricampeão da Copa Libertadores e campeão mundial de clubes, taças erguidas por grandes craques do futebol que vestiram o Manto Sagrado e, é claro, pela Nação Rubro-Negra, sempre atuante como 12º jogador.

O clube colheu os frutos e os números se transformaram em resultado esportivo, com troféus erguidos pelo futebol e pelos esportes olímpicos, conquistando campeonatos nacionais de remo, basquete, ginástica artística, polo aquático, nado artístico e até mesmo esportes eletrônicos. Nos últimos Jogos Olímpicos, em Tóquio e Paris, o Mais Querido teve diversos representantes e fez bonito com as conquistas históricas das ginastas Rebeca Andrade, Jade Barbosa, Lorrane Oliveira e Flavia Saraiva, do canoísta Isaquias Queiroz e da judoca Rafaela Silva, todos atletas rubro-negros.

Já pensou em poder fazer parte de tudo isso?

Trabalhar no Flamengo é diferente de tudo que você já viveu…

Trabalhar com paixão é mágico e muito especial. Ser um colaborador do Flamengo é ver a história sendo escrita de perto, é ter a emoção como colega de trabalho, é sentir como é gratificante fazer parte de grandes conquistas, é fazer parte de uma família e de uma Nação. Venha trabalhar conosco, participar do presente, construir o futuro e valorizar o passado de uma instituição centenária que mexe com o coração de mais de 48 milhões de apaixonados.

Eternos ídolos já vestiram o Manto Sagrado, grandes craques formam nossas equipes, excelentes profissionais constroem a história de sucesso do Flamengo... O próximo pode ser você!

Todo mundo sabe que quem joga pelo Flamengo tem que honrar o Manto Sagrado! Aqui, valorizamos muito o comprometimento, a dedicação, a superação, a resiliência. Para quem é craque do Mengão, não tem bola perdida: a gente entra firme na dividida e se destaca pelo profissionalismo. A busca é incessante pela excelência!

…AMOR E PAIXÃO!

Pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e pelo Flamengo! Você verá que é muito fácil ter paixão pelo seu trabalho com a gente. Ética, transparência, honestidade, profissionalismo, respeito e integridade são titulares do nosso time em todas as partidas. Estamos sempre juntos com garra, otimismo e alegria para vencer!

Zelo pelas pessoas, desenvolvimento e constante aperfeiçoamento. Aqui no Flamengo, queremos ensinar, mas também aprender com você! Muitas são as oportunidades de evoluir com o espírito rubro-negro. Somos um time e uma família!

description:
Location

Remote - US, New York

Employment Type

Full time

Department

Acquisition

Compensation

  • $60K – $65K

Here at Gaia, our employees are the foundation of our success. We believe it's super important that you are happy, healthy, and motivated.

As such, on top of a competitive market bench-marked salary, we offer private healthcare, fertility support and other benefits.

Additionally, we offer all new hires a set up budget in addition to an annual personal development budget to build your skills, knowledge, and potential. We’re working hard on our reward and recognition framework to make sure that those who are excelling above and beyond get what they deserve.

Our vision

Everyone who wants a family should have the chance to try. For the 1 in 6 families that struggle to conceive, fertility treatments are an option but they are expensive. We created the world’s first IVF insurance allowing more people who wish to be parents to pursue treatment with increased financial flexibility. Because the difference between having a child or not should not be how rich you are.

The role

From the very first moment someone considers Gaia as part of their fertility journey, we aim to offer clarity and care. That’s where you come in.

We’re looking for a BDR (Patient Support) to connect with prospects as they consider Gaia for their fertility journey.

You’ll be the first human touchpoint for patients early in their fertility journey; answering questions, building trust, and making sure they feel supported every step of the way.

This is a unique opportunity to support people at one of the most pivotal moments in their lives and help shape how Gaia shows up for them.

  • You’ll work closely with our Marketing team to manage the prospect pipeline for any patient starting their fertility journey in the early stages.

  • You’ll be acting as the main point of contact for prospects and guiding them seamlessly through the initial stages of their journey.

  • You’ll as a point of contact for clinic staff at your assigned clinics to support members book their initial consultations.

  • You’ll book initial calls between “ready to go” patients and our Member Growth Team.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a marketing pipeline of Gaia prospects.

  • Qualify potential members at their early stages throughout inbound forms and outbound sales calls.

  • Support MQLs to book a clinic consultation.

  • Book initial calls between Gaia Prospects and Member Growth Associates.

  • Manage all communication with Prospects via calls and email

  • Effectively carry out processes to track prospects\' initial journey and share data with clinics and the rest of the team.

  • Identify opportunities for increasing our sales pipeline to drive overall Member growth.

You’ll be a great candidate for this role if you:

  • Have minimum 1 year of experience qualifying leads and potential prospects over the phone and via inbound forms required .

  • Experience in the healthcare or fertility space (nice to have).

  • Are empathetic and deeply care about our Members - the IVF experience is incredibly stressful and empathy for what they are going through is a must.

  • Are a self-starter - you’ll be working as part of a small team but also a specific growth project, so we’ll be looking to you to help set us up for success

  • Have strong interpersonal skills - you’ll constantly be communicating with patients, clinic staff and the rest of our company via email and phone calls.

Compensation Range: $60K - $65K

All sourcing and procurement needs to be done against the backdrop of JLL governance and S&P guidelines.

Global Category Manager – Software

Develop, manage and execute global category sourcing strategies within the specific IT Category allocated. As the Software Category Manager you will be responsible for building relationships with the CIO’s, CTO’s, Chief Product Officers, building internal demand plans, developing category plans including new opportunities and manage relationships with key strategic suppliers. Ensure contracting and procurement standards are maintained throughout the portfolio.

Summary of essential functions and Goals

  • Partner with the JLLT leadership team to create category strategies that align with JLLT’s key fundamental plans whilst leveraging growing expenditure to have commercial advantage

  • Develops & regularly maintains/up‑dates short-, mid- and long‑term category strategy globally, linking this strategy with overall business strategy/objectives, in alignment with departmental stakeholders (C‑suite)

  • Category Manager is leading key strategic procurement projects and provides expert advice and guidance to the JLLT leadership team. Advice has expanded from pricing and commercial principles to incorporate aligning supplier/partner strategies to make/buy decisions & managing sensitivities where JLL’s strategy could create direct conflict against the suppliers value proposition

  • The Category Manager will recommend the qualification of appropriate service providers/supply partners to ensure that we have the best service provision available across the region to deliver value to our internal and sometimes also external clients

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for global category strategy development, execution and category performance of all category related activities & objectives for corporate category requirements as well as other JLL entities if required. Ensuring alignment across the JLLT Leadership team

  • Delivery of financial targets in line with business expectations. Category Manager continuously drives the category opportunity agenda and self‑sufficiently identifies, agrees and executes these projects

  • Accountable for creating strategic solution for specific commodity/service requirements, procurement event planning, RFP/quotation management, bid analysis and recommendations, liaison with internal stakeholders for contract approvals, savings reporting, documentation and compliance.

  • Create and manage the category project calendar, lead category events, bid process, commercial evaluation, recommendations, contract document preparation and functional reviews

  • Approvals according to JLL Delegation of Authority. Compliance with JLL procedures as applicable. This includes presenting and seeking approval from Global CEO of JLLT, Global CPO and Global CFO

  • Rationalizes supply base and develops clear strategic supply partner framework and maintains this framework at senior supplier level

  • Use Global, Regional and Country, market and industry intelligence to identify and qualify new suppliers and use data to support the business and delivery of services. In addition, identify risk, threats and provide solutions for mitigation.

  • Provide functional leadership and peer group alignment, where appropriate and needed

  • Identify opportunities to develop and implement new policies and procedures, including rationalization of legacy policies and procedures

  • Actively engage in and support the use of e‑procurement strategy, methodology and deployment

  • Prepare high quality papers and presentations for use with internal and external stakeholders and/or teams as required

  • Apply ethical company standards and ensure Global Procurement policy is applied at all times

Ability to Manage the Sourcing Process

  • Develop category plan with the ability to provide visibility such as supplier summaries, stakeholder engagement plans, contract summaries, and market insights that lead to both short and long‑term strategies

  • Ability to negotiate and have proven strategies within areas of corporate spend

  • Lead development and execution of all sourcing‑related functions: performing due diligence and assessment of prospective suppliers, executing RFPs/bids, negotiating contracts and ensuring effective transition to operations during implementation

  • Partner with CIO’s and the business to drive both immediate and sustained benefits to JLL Corporate

  • Bring strategic thought leadership to identify additional cost and operational efficiencies. Individual must be able to consider bigger picture goals and scenarios. The individual has to be able to clearly articulate and advise senior members of JLL on decisions that could impact business line performance

  • Proactively manage internal stakeholder expectations and escalation at appropriate times

  • Savings – working with sourcing managers and key suppliers, ensure that savings initiatives ideas are being driven to maximize savings impacts

  • Ensure that the savings tracker across country is kept up‑to‑date for the category so that we can demonstrate value add to our internal stakeholders

  • Conduct Preferred Supplier performance review meetings, manage supplier scorecards, contract compliance and service obligations

  • Subject matter expert for category and considered to be the channel of choice within JLL

Sound like you? To apply you need to have:

  • Excellent Inter‑personal skills, Organization skills, Strong gravitas and influencing skills with senior business leaders

  • Ability work on a global scale and across different regions. This includes the ability to meet and align category plans with global vertical stakeholders

  • Excellent communication skills – oral and written

  • Proven ability to facilitate strategic supplier relationships and work with senior business executives and across procurement leadership

  • Collaborative and influencing style with a focus on team work

  • Proven ability to deliver results in challenging environments

  • Expertise in sourcing with demonstrated ability to manage change

  • Ability to sell and present initiatives and/or new ideas

  • Experience in sourcing indirect corporate services and products

  • Excellent PC skills, proficient in MS applications with excellent ability to work with large amounts of data and build reports

  • Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) from four‑year college university

  • Minimum 7 years of strategic sourcing experience (majority within IT and technology)

  • CPSM certification preferred

  • MBA preferred

Location

  • Role to be based in North America (USA or Canada)

  • As part of the role, individuals must have the flexibility to deal with projects in different time zones and manage their time accordingly

What you can expect from us

You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like‑minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.

Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay. We’ll offer you a competitive salary and benefits package.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)

About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS / CRM, etc.).

Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), document intelligence, and structured extraction. This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function—defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.

The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments / write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets / Excel / Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.

What You’ll Build

Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.

Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date / format rules, name / DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG / OT).

Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs / webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems, healthcare compliance platforms, job boards, CRM / Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).

Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS / CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies / MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.

Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP / SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS / Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.

Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage / routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.

Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI; landing / job content in HubSpot CMS, Webflow, or WordPress.

Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.

Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:

  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits / adjustments.
  • Sync AR / AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.

Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence / SharePoint / Drive / ATS / CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.

Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets, Excel, and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.

MLOps & Platform

Dataset / prompt / embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline / online evals; A / B tests.

CI / CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency / reliability SLOs; canary / blue-green.

Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries / backoff, dead-letter handling).

Observability (traces / metrics / cost), drift detection, PII / HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.

Cost governance: token / throughput controls, caching / TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.

Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and / or C#.
  • Hands-on LLM / RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF / HTML / images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design (HIPAA / PII), APIs / webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS / Compliance / Job Boards / HubSpot / Salesforce).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing / payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals: data / model versioning, CI / CD, monitoring, rollback.

Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing / credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS / workflow tools (Zapier / Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS / App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI / LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.

Why AMX

Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.

Executive air cover: Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.

Modern, open stack: Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM / Marketing (HubSpot / Salesforce), VoIP / SMS, CMS, accounting / payroll, and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.

Mission-critical outcomes: Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.

Remote-first, pragmatic culture: Production over prototypes, HIPAA / PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.

EEO

AMX Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Cientista de Dados Sênior - Squad Recomendações


Join to apply for the Cientista de Dados Sênior - Squad Recomendações role at Magazine Luiza


Sobre nós


O Magalu é uma das maiores empresas de varejo do Brasil, reconhecida por sua inovação e presença digital. O time de tecnologia do Magalu é formado por profissionais inovadores e apaixonados por transformar o varejo digital. Com foco em soluções ágeis e escaláveis, desenvolvem projetos que impactam milhões de clientes. Em um ambiente colaborativo, buscam constantemente a excelência em tecnologia e inovação.


Descrição da vaga


Estamos buscando pessoas para trabalhar em nosso time de recomendação do Luizalabs, responsável por manter e evoluir a plataforma que personaliza a experiência de nossos clientes Magalu. Temos desafios como alta disponibilidade, performance, machine learning e engenharia de dados! Em outras palavras, focamos em micro-serviços, pipelines de dados e algoritmos.


Conhecimentos e habilidades necessários



  • Habilidades avançadas com programação em Python.

  • Fortes habilidades analíticas quantitativas para interpretar dados, desenvolver features e propor soluções com Ciência de Dados.

  • Sólido conhecimento teórico e prático de técnicas de IA e modelagem de Machine Learning (aprendizado de máquina supervisionado, semi-supervisionado e não supervisionado).

  • Conhecimento avançado em bibliotecas e plataformas de DS/ML/IA do mercado (transformers, pandas, scikit-learn, tensorflow, pytorch, pyspark, mllib, etc)

  • Habilidade de se comunicar com pessoas do time de negócios e das demais áreas de engenharia.

  • Conhecimento de Deep Learning.


Conhecimentos e habilidades diferenciais



  • Conhecimentos avançados em ambientes distribuídos para dados (com Delta Lake) com uso de BigQuery e/ou SQL, PySpark, Polars e Dask.

  • Técnicas Avançadas para problemas multimodais.

  • Embeddings Multimodais (Construção de modelos próprios de embeddings, como também, o uso de embeddings pré-treinadas).

  • IA Gen com LLMOps (SGLang, etc), MCP, RAGs, etc.

  • Conhecimentos avançados em orquestração de workflows de ML com pipelines escaláveis (Kube Flow, MLflow, Argo, …).

  • Causal Inference.

  • Conhecimentos e habilidades práticas em Foundation Models aplicadas em NLP e Imagens.

  • Uso de bibliotecas e datasets de NLP para o Português-BR (transformers, nltk, spaCy, gensim, etc).


Como Cientista De Dados, Você Poderá



  • Explorar os dados de forma analítica e avançada para compreender sua qualidade e relevância para as modelagens;

  • Propor a criação de novas variáveis preditivas relevantes para os modelos de aprendizado de máquina;

  • Estudar, propor e criar modelos para a detecção de padrões nos dados (ex. CF, Clusterização, Classificação etc.), com o objetivo de fazer previsões automatizadas;

  • Criar e testar modelos para detecção de padrões, classificação, clusterização e recomendações. Em NLP, aplicar tanto abordagens clássicas quanto modelos pré-treinados (Transformer, BERT, GPT, etc.), uso de Foundation Models, com atenção a problemas fuzzy, como ambiguidades, incertezas na interpretação e ausência de dados (missing data) nos textos.

  • Analisar e avaliar as métricas de aprendizado e generalização dos modelos e fazer sua correlação com métricas de negócio, adaptando estratégias conforme desafios como inconsistências linguísticas e de imagens;

  • Propor novas variáveis, como contagens, embeddings e indicadores de modelos, que ajudem a captar nuances e aspectos dos dados multimodais.

  • Integrar dados de fontes diversas para complementar informações e gerar variáveis mais robustas e contextuais.

  • Monitorar os modelos em produção (Drift de dados, métrica, tempo de execução, etc).

  • Sempre que apropriado, publicar os achados científicos em periódicos ou para a comunidade em geral.

title: Product Owner Senior (ProdOps)
description:
Job description

Você irá exercer um papel de extrema importância no crescimento da doc9 como Product Owner Senior (ProdOPS) , atuando diretamente na sustentação de um dos nossos produtos digitais .

Essa vaga é ideal para quem tem perfil de ProdOPS , gosta de trabalhar com múltiplas áreas (Dev, CX, Suporte), e sabe que um produto vivo e estável é tão estratégico quanto um novo lançamento.

A doc9 é uma lawtech com marca consolidada no mercado jurídico com seus serviços de marketplace (cálculos, audiências e outras diligências) e que cresce em ritmo exponencial com produtos puramente tecnológicos (SaaS), como o Whom.doc9 e o eHealth.doc9 .

Somos formados por gente inquieta e empreendedora, que valoriza o trabalho em equipe e acredita que o crescimento sustentável se dá a partir de pessoas que amam o que fazem.

Estamos em busca de pessoas engajadas, que tenham brilho no olho e muita vontade de se desenvolver e crescer com a gente.

Main responsibilities

Como Product Owner Senior (ProdOPS) , seu papel será garantir a saúde e evolução operacional do produto , transformando incidentes e demandas do dia a dia em oportunidades de melhoria contínua. Buscamos um profissional sênior de ProdOPS, com experiência comprovada em sustentação e operação de produtos digitais complexos.

Você atuará junto a desenvolvedores, Suporte e CX, conectando tecnologia e operação para manter a performance, reduzir gargalos e fortalecer a experiência dos nossos usuários e parceiros internos .

  • Assegurar a continuidade e a excelência operacional do produto, garantindo estabilidade, performance e disponibilidade em todos os ambientes;
  • Atuar como elo estratégico entre Tecnologia, Suporte e CX, priorizando e direcionando resoluções de incidentes, bugs e melhorias com base em impacto e valor para o negócio;
  • Gerir o fluxo de demandas e tickets com visão crítica, estruturando processos que tragam previsibilidade, priorização clara e agilidade na execução;
  • Analisar causas-raiz e padrões recorrentes, liderando junto ao time ações corretivas e preventivas que reduzam falhas e aumentem a confiabilidade do sistema;
  • Identificar e acompanhar evoluções incrementais de produto, desde ajustes técnicos até melhorias de usabilidade que tornem a operação mais fluida e sustentável;
  • Garantir comunicação estruturada com stakeholders e demais squads, consolidando informações sobre incidentes, planos de ação e status de resolução com clareza executiva;
  • Atuar com liderança e serenidade em situações críticas, conduzindo priorizações e decisões sob pressão com foco em estabilidade e transparência;
  • Consolidar aprendizados e evoluções da operação, transformando-os em boas práticas e processos que reforcem a maturidade e previsibilidade da tribo.

Requirements and skills

Para ser o nosso novo talento você precisa:

  • Perfil sênior, analítico e proativo , com domínio de metodologias e mentalidade ProdOPS ;
  • Capacidade de atuar com estrutura e serenidade em ambientes de alta demanda ;
  • Visão crítica e curiosidade genuína para melhorar processos e antecipar riscos;
  • Boa escuta, empatia e habilidade para integrar tecnologia, suporte e negócio;
  • Autonomia para agir e discernimento para escalar, equilibrando urgência e estratégia ;
  • Paixão por garantir estabilidade, previsibilidade e evolução contínua de produtos digitais ;
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar padrões, causas-raiz e indicadores operacionais, transformando dados em planos de ação concretos ;
  • Habilidade de navegar entre o técnico e o estratégico , traduzindo necessidades do negócio para o time de desenvolvimento e vice-versa;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento , com postura colaborativa e capacidade de alinhar decisões sob pressão ;
  • Perfil resiliente, estruturado e orientado à melhoria contínua , com senso de urgência equilibrado e foco em resultado mensurável .

E os seguintes conhecimentos e experiências:

  • Experiência sólida em operações de produto digital (ProdOPS, Sustentação ou Gestão de Incidentes) , com histórico de atuação em produtos SaaS de alta criticidade ;
  • Domínio das principais práticas e frameworks de ProdOPS , como ITSM, Problem Management, Incident Response e Continuous Improvement;
  • Experiência em coordenação de fluxos operacionais e gestão de demandas , com domínio de priorização baseada em impacto, risco e urgência;
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com alto volume de tickets, múltiplas squads e interações entre times de CX, Suporte e Tecnologia ;
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de gestão de incidentes e backlog (Jira, Movidesk, ClickUp, Zendesk, Freshdesk, etc.);
  • Conhecimento de métricas operacionais (SLA, MTTR, TTR, taxa de reabertura, volume e severidade de incidentes);
  • Conhecimento e experiência com estratégias data driven , consumo de dados e clareza nos insights para gerar ações práticas;
  • Experiência na condução de post-mortems, análises de causa-raiz e rituais de melhoria contínua (Kaizen, RCA, 5 Whys, PDCA);
  • Vivência com gestão de crise e incident response , atuando em cenários de alta pressão com clareza e priorização;
  • Vivência em times com metodologias ágeis para desenvolvimento;
  • Interesse em automação de processos operacionais, integrações leves, monitoramentos e scripts de apoio (altamente desejável);
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Postman ou ferramentas de inspeção técnica (diferencial).

Ferramentas, Tecnologias e Linguagens Necessárias:

  • Gestão de produto e backlog: Jira, Confluence, Linear ou ClickUp;
  • Mapeamento e discovery colaborativo: Miro ou FigJam;
  • Métricas e insights de uso: Metabase, Amplitude ou GA4;
  • Testes e documentação de APIs (diferencial): Postman, Swagger ou Insomnia;
  • Conceitos técnicos (diferencial): JSON, APIs REST, Webhooks e Tokens.

Additional information

  • Contratação via PJ ;
  • 100% remoto;
  • + Benefícios

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo. O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade :

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Tecnospeed é uma empresa brasileira especializada em soluções tecnológicas para Desenvolvedores de Software. Referência Nacional em escrituração fiscal e soluções financeiras. Com foco em inovação, governança e inteligência de dados, a Tecnospeed atua como parceira estratégica de empresas privadas e profissionais autônomos, desenvolvendo produtos e serviços que asseguram conformidade com as exigências regulatórias. Ganhadora das Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar no GPTW Nacional e Regional no Setor de Tecnologia. Reconhecida na área de Gestão em Inovação pelo PNI e sempre colocando PESSOAS em primeiro lugar.

Formação Acadêmica :

Doutorado em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto :

Reescrita e modernização de componentes críticos dos produtos

Principais Atividades :

  • Produzir código limpo, legível, modular e testável , facilitando manutenções futuras e evolução contínua;
  • Reduzir a complexidade técnica e os riscos de regressão;
  • Melhorar o desempenho das aplicações, otimizando respostas e consumo de recursos;
  • Aumentar a confiabilidade e estabilidade dos sistemas por meio de testes automatizados e cobertura robusta ;
  • Integrar ferramentas de inteligência artificial para acelerar a codificação, revisar código e reforçar a qualidade técnica;
  • Promover entregas com ganhos tangíveis de qualidade percebida pelo cliente final ;

Estabelecer padrões reutilizáveis de desenvolvimento e construir um legado técnico escalável dentro da empresa.

Implemente métricas, logs e rastreamento distribuído.

Conhecimento necessário :

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de software ;
  • Conhecimentos em Node.js , PHP , Delphi , com uso de TypeScript ;
  • Vivência em construção e manutenção de APIs ;
  • Experiência com GitLab para versionamento;
  • Conhecimento básico em serviços cloud (AWS e Oracle Cloud Infrastructure);
  • Atuação com metodologias ágeis .

Domínio de bancos de dados :

Relacional : PostgreSQL

Não relacional : MongoDB , DynamoDB

Conhecimento desejável :

  • Inglês técnico (leitura e escrita);
  • Experiência com documentação técnica ;
  • Certificações como AWS Cloud Practitioner ou OCI Foundations Associate .

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Remoto

Soft Skills :

Autogestão; Trabalho em equipe; Criatividade; Organização; Ética e responsabilidade.

description:
CRA I or II - São Paulo - Home based

ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

We are currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team at ICON Plc. As a key member of our research department, you will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating clinical trials, ensuring compliance with regulations, and collecting and analyzing critical data.

What you will be doing

  • Working independently and actively to coordinate all activities for setting up and monitoring a study, completing accurate study status reports and maintaining study documentation
  • Running sponsor generated queries efficiently and taking responsibility for study cost efficiency; you will also participate in the preparation and review of study documentation and feasibility studies for new proposals as required.
  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key stakeholders, clinical investigators, and site staff.
  • Ensure patient safety by ensuring compliance with ICON’s procedures, protocols, and regulatory requirements.

Your profile

  • University degree in medicine, science, or equivalent
  • Knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and the expertise to review and evaluate medical data
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English
  • Good social skills enabling you to deal with queries in a timely manner
  • Ability to travel at least 60% of the time (international and domestic - fly and drive) and should possess a valid drivers license

What ICON can offer you:

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our benefits examples include:

  • Various annual leave entitlements
  • A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
  • Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
  • Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
  • Life assurance
  • Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know or submit a request here

  • Participar das cerimônias de produto e acompanhar a jornada de desenvolvimento utilizando ferramenta no Azure DevOps.

Requirements and skills

  • Domínio deFigma para design de interfaces, prototipação e e sistemas de design.
  • Experiência prática com pesquisa de usabilidade (entrevistas, testes moderados e não moderados).
  • Capacidade de conduzir e analisar testes de usabilidade e A/B Testing.
  • Experiência com design system: criação, manutenção e aplicação.

Responsible for day-to-day activities and delivery of Global Regulatory Affairs support services. Project Support

  • Regularly respond to registration requests and work with project teams to identify regulatory requirements.
  • Assist in the preparation of regulatory submissions and support summaries.
  • Ensure project/clinical site files and documents are developed, maintained, revised, archived and/or destroyed in accordance with project and regulatory requirements and that all project stakeholders are fully informed and trained on all applicable regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

  • Applicants should have a minimum of an undergraduate degree and 4-6 years of relevant experience in Clinical Research/Regulatory Affairs.

title: Business Management & Order Analyst (AMER)
description:
The Role & Team:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive professional to manage the full order-to-revenue cycle — from deal structuring and validation to order processing, delivery coordination, invoicing readiness, and revenue forecasting. This role serves as a key liaison between Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to ensure accuracy, compliance, and efficiency across all commercial operations, with a strong focus on adherence to IFRS 15 revenue recognition principles.

Key Responsibilities:

Deal Review & Structuring

  • Review and validate sales opportunities in Salesforce/CPQ or ERP, ensuring accurate product configuration, pricing, margins, and documentation.
  • Advise Sales on deal structures, acceptance criteria, and contractual terms that impact bookings and revenue recognition.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual and documentation requirements (NDAs, certificates, deal registration forms, contracts, SOWs).

Order Processing & Fulfillment Coordination

  • Review and process customer Purchase Orders (POs) in accordance with company policies and compliance standards.
  • Coordinate with Supply Chain/Logistics for hardware and appliance deliveries, and manage software e-delivery notifications.
  • Process internal/demo sales orders and ensure all orders are properly documented in ERP/CRM systems.
  • Monitor delivery milestones and coordinate with Billing for timely invoicing.

Revenue Forecasting & Tracking

  • Maintain and update the Revenue Schedule at the start of each quarter and on a weekly basis to reflect deal changes.
  • Consolidate input from Sales, Professional Services, Finance, and Supply Chain to support accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Track project completion, acceptance milestones, and payment status to ensure timely revenue recognition.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting

  • Lead or participate in weekly meetings to track deal progress, delivery timelines, technical issues, and payment updates.
  • Work closely with Credit Management on credit checks and customer credit status.
  • Support RFP reviews with financial and operational input.
  • Maintain trackers and reports (e.g., Order Management Tracker, Bookings Tie-Up Report) to ensure visibility on order and revenue status.

Skills & Requirements

  • Experience: 2+ years in revenue operations, order management, sales operations, deal desk, or similar roles.
  • Systems: Proficiency in Salesforce, CPQ, ERP systems (Oracle/SAP), and Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas).
  • Knowledge: Understanding of revenue recognition principles (IFRS 15), quote-to-cash processes, and sales lifecycle operations.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong attention to detail and ability to assess revenue and operational impacts.
  • Communication: Clear and professional communication skills for effective cross-functional collaboration.
  • Organization: Strong ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

title: Strategic Customer Success Account Manager
description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you\'ll do

The Docusign Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM) is responsible for a portfolio of accounts and renewals in an assigned territory. The CSAM serves as a customer adoption advisor, driving a return on our customers’ investment in Docusign and unlocking further digitalization. Within their defined territory, the CSAM is responsible for developing and implementing effective customer success and value strategies, identifying growth opportunities, negotiating favorable renewal terms, and providing insights to the business and customers that improve future outcomes. This role will be a valuable member of the Account team, working in collaboration with our Sales Team (Account Executives). The ideal candidate will drive accountability with themselves and their business partners, thriving in a fast-paced environment.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Customer Success Account Management.

Responsibilities

  • Prevent risk and drive growth in our customers through early engagement, driving value, engaging with key partners as measured by renewal outcomes
  • Achieve financial and strategic revenue, bookings and billings targets
  • Maintain and update accurately a rolling forecast of your territory and communicate any renewal risk to internal resources in order to develop resolution strategies
  • Own and implement win/win negotiation strategies for Docusign’s strategic renewals while protecting and improving customer trust
  • Conduct regular business reviews with our customers to ensure that they are embraced and deriving value from our product, and we are aligned with their primary objectives
  • Be accountable for the full adoption strategy, using key partners across the Docusign ecosystem to deliver comprehensive paths for success
  • Serve as the primary point of contact and facilitation on behalf of our customers for any escalation concerns
  • Collaborate with internal resources such as, but not limited to, Sales, Customer Success, Pricing, Legal, Revenue Operations and Product Management to develop growth and risk mitigation strategies for key accounts
  • Improve account growth by taking a major role within the account team, helping to identify incremental growth opportunities within the account, and involving the appropriate internal resources where applicable
  • Evaluate your portfolio and optimally analyze usage, health, data, and behavioral patterns to prioritize time to render the most favorable outcomes for the customer and Docusign
  • Follow best practices for all internal processes including, opportunity management, data quality and accuracy, CRM hygiene, quotes and forecasting
  • Be an owner of the renewal process, ensuring that key timelines are met and the renewal is mutually beneficial

Job Designation

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position\'s job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • 8+ years of experience within Sales, Renewal Management, Account Management and/or Customer Success within SaaS offerings
  • Experience with quota-carrying roles and proven history of meeting key performance indicators
  • Experience with deal negotiation cycles with a successful track record
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience

Preferred

  • Strong contract negotiation skills with experience driving contracts to completion on-time
  • Experience with supporting adoption across organizations, serving as a change agent for the customer
  • Ability to demonstrate a strategic approach to enable persuasive value conversations with customers at an executive level
  • Ability to react and adapt to potential rapid shifts in priorities
  • Strong level of urgency, organization and prioritization skills
  • Salesforce experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to convey value through interactions with customers

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

description:
Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location and Flexibility

This role can be fully remote for candidates based in the states of São Paulo and Rio Grande do Sul as well as in the cities of Rio de Janeiro and Belo Horizonte, due to team distribution and occasional in-person opportunities. If you are based in São Paulo or Porto Alegre, you are welcome to work from one of our offices on a flexible schedule.

The Opportunity

As a Data Engineer part of our growing Data Science team, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines, enabling efficient data integration, storage, and processing across our various data sources. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and other technical stakeholders, to ensure data quality and support data-driven decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and optimize scalable, high-performing, secure, and reliable data pipelines that address diverse business needs and considerations
  • Identify opportunities to enhance internal processes, implement automation to streamline manual tasks, and contribute to infrastructure redesign
  • Act as a guide and mentor to junior engineers, supporting their professional growth and fostering an inclusive working environment
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data quality and support data-driven decision-making to strive for greater functionality in our data systems
  • Collaborate with project managers and product owners to assist in prioritizing, estimating, and planning development tasks
  • Provide constructive feedback, and share expertise with fellow team members, fostering mutual growth and learning
  • Engage in ongoing research and adoption of new technologies, libraries, frameworks, and best practices to enhance the capabilities of the data team
  • Demonstrate a commitment to accessibility and ensure that your work considers and positively impacts others

title: Quality Engineer (Brazil)
description:
FileCloud is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Quality Engineer (Platform) to join our team in Brazil.
